gesture.summary: Draw a single stroke in the caption area to send the linked quick text.
gesture.m_shape: Start at the bottom left and draw an M in one stroke.
gesture.w_shape: Start at the top left and draw a W in one stroke.
gesture.z_shape: Start at the top left, go right, diagonally down left, then right.
gesture.lightning: Start at the top right and draw a zigzag down to the bottom left.
gesture.hourglass: Start at the top left, draw diagonally down right, then go back up and down left.
gesture.folded_hook: Start at the top left, go down and around the bottom, then turn up right and curl inward.
permission.quick: Gesture shortcuts read quick texts to link and send the selected entries.
